electrode_metal: copper (250 nm on 10 nm titanium adhesion, contact pads; sputtered Cu air bridges)

epitaxy_or_stack: 40 nm vertical slot between two 250 nm wide, 250 nm high silicon rails (Table 1); 50 nm pedestal named in the poling paragraph; 5 nm TiO2 (ALD, 150 C) on all surfaces including the slot; air-bridge interconnects over the waveguide (1.3 um MaN 2410 reflow support); tunable directional couplers protected by FoX; lightly doped silicon
notes: VPI CONTRADICTION kept visible (audit F1, 2026-10-03): the abstract (p.1) says measurement results indicate VpiL below 1.2 V.mm 'are possible' for balanced MZMs with this slot, but the only measurement of this 1 mm device, Fig. 11 (p.12), is a spectral shift of about 120 pm for 1 V with FSR about 1.15 nm. That gives Vpi = FSR / (2 x 0.12 nm/V) = 4.8 V, i.e. VpiL = 4.8 V.mm (0.48 V.cm), a factor of 4.0 above the abstract bound; reading the two nulls in the Fig. 11 render gives a spacing of about 1.3 nm (marker labelled 1.15 nm), which would give about 5.4 V.mm. The body states no measured Vpi, drive or convention and the authors do not reconcile the two, so vpil_dc_vcm, vpi_basis and vpi_convention are left empty instead of entering either number. Measured spectral shift 120 pm for 1 V with FSR about 1.15 nm (Fig. 11, p.12). Peak poling current 206 nA with TiO2, below one third of the untreated slot (Fig. 10(b), p.11-12); poling at 100 V/um minimum, 80 to 150 C ramp, Tg about 145 C. Prior work cited by the paper (CLEO 2018) gave VpiL 3.125 V.mm without TiO2 and 2.39 V.mm with 5 nm TiO2 (40 nm slots), not entered. Fig. 12 (simulation) shows VpiL about 0.46 V.mm (no TiO2) falling to about 0.23 V.mm (10 nm TiO2) for a 40 nm slot, read by eye, not entered. Electrode type, drive and measurement temperature are not stated; focus is poling and infiltration, not high-speed modulation.

Projection, not a fabricated device: the measured devices use lightly doped silicon. Model parameters in Table 1 (p.5): r33 100 pm/V assumed, arm length 0.5 mm, slot 40 nm, TiO2 5 nm. Fig. 12(a) reads about 0.36 V.mm at 5 nm TiO2 for the 40 nm slot (by eye, not entered). Convention (per-arm vs MZM) and operating wavelength not stated for the projection.

device_label: Unslotted fishbone cavity, EO converter device (SEO100C)
substrate: float-zone SOI (Shin-Etsu), 220 nm silicon device layer, 3 um buried oxide, substrate resistivity > 3 kOhm cm
epitaxy_or_stack: Unperturbed silicon strip 290 nm wide, 220 nm tall, 420 um long between sinusoidally width-modulated (fishbone) photonic-crystal reflectors (5-10 full-strength periods plus 10 ramp periods each side); capacitor of a lambda/4 coplanar-waveguide resonator: two 3 um wide Al electrodes, gap 2.7 um, length 450 um; about 35 percent of the mode energy in the polymer
notes: Q and temperature: loaded Q 19,900 and Fano fit at about 7 mK (Fig. 7(a,b)); EO tuning 3.70 pm/V measured at room temperature on the same resonance (Fig. 7(c,d)); temperature_class left empty (mixed). Tuning stable up to 10 MHz (generator limit). Transduction (not columns): microwave resonance 6.672 GHz (lambda/4 CPW, about 100 ohm, 5200 um), conversion efficiency 2.2e-9 at -26 dBm pump and -31 dBm RF, conversion bandwidth 20.3 MHz, sideband contrast 9.5 dB, g0/2pi 330 +/- 60 Hz inferred and 400 Hz predicted (Table 1, p.19). After UV fiber gluing the tuning fell from 3.7 to 1.1 pm/V, lowering efficiency about 11x (p.13). The poled polymer has ne 1.70 and no 1.65; poling at about 300 V (100 V/um) up to Tg about 135 C (p.6). Wavelength value is the abstract's; Table 1 gives 192.6 THz (about 1556.6 nm), Fig. 7(b) about 1557.9 nm.
